title: Sakin Kyber 0.26
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Mun fitar da sigarmu ta 0.26 mai ɗauke da manyan sabuntawa guda uku: ingantaccen allon kwafi, tantancewa ta OpenID Connect, da inganta tsarin sarrafa bidiyo da sauti. Akwai kuma ƙananan gyare-gyare masu yawa.
html:
Kyber 0.26!

Kyber 0.26 ta fito.

Wannan sakin ya zo musamman da tallafin tantancewa ta OIDC, manyan ci gaba a ɓangaren tsara bidiyo, da ingantaccen allon kwafi a dukkan dandamali. Akwai kuma sababbin hanyoyin ɗaukar hoton allo a Linux, tare da gyare-gyare da dama da suka ƙara inganci da daidaito a dukkan sassan manhajar kwamfuta.

Ga muhimman abubuwan da sakin ya ƙunsa.

Tallafin OIDC

Yanzu Kyber na goyon bayan OpenID Connect (OIDC) wajen tantance masu amfani, a cikin kycontroller da manhajar kwamfuta. Za ku iya haɗa Kyber da tsarin tantance shaidar da kuke amfani da shi a yanzu—ko Keycloak, ko Auth0, ko Authelia, ko kowane tsarin SSO da ya bi ƙa’idojin da aka amince da su.

Wannan babban ci gaba ne ga ƙungiyoyi da kamfanonin da ke amfani da Kyber inda masu amfani da yawa ke aiki tare. A irin waɗannan wurare, sarrafa shaidar masu amfani daga wuri ɗaya sharaɗi ne na dole.

Ingantaccen allon kwafi

Sarrafa allon kwafi ya samu gagarumin ci gaba a wannan sakin. Yanzu kwamfutocin Linux masu amfani da X11 za su iya raba allon kwafi. A Windows kuma, an ƙara cikakken tallafin allon kwafi na HTML a kan na rubutu zalla da aka gabatar a baya. Yanzu za a iya kwafa da liƙa abubuwa masu salo—kamar rubutu mai ado, hanyoyin haɗi, da bayanai masu tsari—tsakanin kwamfutoci a Windows kamar yadda ake yi a kwamfuta guda.

Ci gaba a tsara bidiyo

An ɗaga kymedia zuwa FFmpeg 8.1, wanda ya kawo sababbin ci gaba a ɓangaren kodek, gyaran kurakurai, da ƙarin saurin aiki daga tushen aikin.

An inganta saitunan tsara bidiyo na AMF (AMD) da VAAPI sosai, kuma hakan ya rage jinkiri a zahiri. Masu amfani da AMD musamman za su ga bambancin: yanzu jinkirin tsara bidiyo ya kusa kaiwa matakin da ake tsammani daga Nvidia.

A Windows, yanzu kymedia/vlc na amfani da daidaitaccen GUID na Microsoft don rage samfurin launi na HEVC 4:2:2 da 4:4:4, maimakon wanda ya keɓanta ga Intel. Wannan ya ba da damar aiki da nau’o’in na’urori masu yawa, kuma ya fi inganci da dogaro a aikace.

Sababbin hanyoyin ɗaukar hoton allo a Linux

kymedia ta samu sababbin zaɓuɓɓuka biyu na grab_backend, wato xcb da wlroots. Yanzu masu amfani da Linux suna da tallafin ɗaukar hoton allo na asali a tsarin X11 da kuma tsarin wlroots (Wayland), wanda ke faɗaɗa dacewarta da muhallan kwamfuta daban-daban.

Mai sarrafa WebSocket yanzu na amfani da kycom

Yanzu controller/ws na amfani da kycom wajen mu’amala da kyavserver da kynput, maimakon tsohuwar hanyar sadarwa kai tsaye. Ta haka ya yi daidai da sauran sassan tsarin.

Gyare-gyaren daidaito

Gyare-gyare da dama sun magance wasu yanayi na musamman da ka iya haddasa faɗuwar manhaja, sake farawa ba ƙarewa, ko kurakurai masu rikitarwa:

kycontroller/win32 : Rashin nasarar ɗora gunkin sanarwa ba zai ƙara dakatar da manhajar ba. Kyber na farfaɗowa cikin sauƙi idan ta karɓi saƙon TaskbarCreated, don haka tana aiki daidai ko da Explorer ya sake farawa ko sandar ayyuka ta yi jinkirin bayyana.

kyservice/win32 : Sabis ɗin ba zai ƙara maimaita kansa ba iyaka ba idan ya ci karo da saiti mara inganci.

kycontroller : Adadin masu haɗi da ake nunawa a gunkin sanarwa yanzu yana sabuntuwa daidai idan lokacin wani zama ya ƙare.

kycontroller : Tsarin sa ido yanzu ya zama na zaɓi.

kycontroller : An gyara hanyar RTP. Ta daina aiki ba tare da wata sanarwa ba tun bayan da aka ƙara tallafin IPv6 a 0.25.0.

Ayyukan taimako na sauya lambobin maɓallai yanzu suna samuwa a dukkan dandamali

Yanzu kynput na fitar da ayyukan taimako na sauya lambobin maɓallan madannai a dukkan dandamali. Wannan zai amfani masu haɗa tsarin da ke buƙatar sarrafa lambobin maɓallai iri ɗaya, ko wane tsarin aiki suke nufi.

Yanar gizo: sabon salon tambari da sake tsara masu kunna bidiyo da sauti

Shafin yanar gizo ya zo da sabon salon tambarin Kyber. A ɓangaren kyctl kuma, an fitar da masu kunna bidiyo da sauti zuwa fakitocin Rust daban-daban, wanda zai sauƙaƙa kula da lambar manhajar da kuma faɗaɗa ta a nan gaba.

Sabuntawa

Kyber 0.26 tana nan a yanzu. Ku je shafin saukarwa don samun sabuwar sigar, ko ku jawo sabbin fakitocin ta hanyar da kuka saba amfani da ita.

Muna maraba da ra’ayoyinku da rahotannin kurakurai.
